{{Top|leg}}
'''Docking Port 12 Berth 13''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located on [[Yag-prime]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] orbiting the [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]].<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] launched an [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (26 ABY)|attack]] on [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. In thanks for their help and warning of the defense grid sabotage, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Anakin Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] were given permission by [[Dodecian]] [[Illiet]] to commandeer the ship there for their escape.<ref name="Rebirth" />
